stories.headline: Labor market faltered in September as jobs increased by just 29,000, unemployment rate rose to 4.2%
stories.summary: Nonfarm payrolls rose by just 29,000 in September, well below the 84,000 forecast, and the unemployment rate rose to 4.2%, the Bureau of Labor Statistics said.

stories.headline: U.S. natural gas production reached a record high in July 2026
stories.summary: U.S. natural gas production hit an all-time high in July 2026, driven primarily by increased output in the Permian Basin, according to our latest Natural Gas Monthly.
